messages:
maya: Quick watercooler q — what's the first podcast that totally hooked you? drop the episode link or a one-liner about why it grabbed you :headphones:

jamal: Reply All — the early ep about the weird internet scam. the mix of journalism + behind-the-scenes internet stuff made me binge everything they had. :mindblown:

lina: Radiolab 'Colors' (ish) — sound design and storytelling felt cinematic, like radio for your brain. sent the link: https://www.wnycstudios.org/podcasts/radiolab/episodes

aaron: Serial S1E1 (Adnan) — changed how I listen to true crime and longform. suddenly 20-min episodes weren't enough.

sofia: This American Life ep about the tiny weird town (can't remember the title) but it made me want to sit and listen for hours. my dad was the enabler. :heart:

tom: Song Exploder first ep I heard was Fleetwood Mac — the way artists deconstruct songs made me actually appreciate production. cried on subway. no shame.

elena: No Such Thing As A Fish — started as a joke rec from a friend, now it's my go-to for walks. absurd and fast. :laughing:

spotify-bot: Suggested playlist: "First Podcast Episodes" — https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DXc9H0q0dS9z7 (automated recs based on thread)

maya: Love these. quick follow-up — if someone new asked for a single episode to try, reply with the category (narrative/comedy/music) + one ep rec. Go!

jamal: narrative: S-Town S1 (start at ep1)

lina: music: Song Exploder — Fleetwood Mac ep

aaron: comedy: No Such Thing As A Fish — try any ep with the hosts riffing on weird facts

sofia: narrative: This American Life 'Act One' episodes are a safe bet

tom: music: Dissect ep on Kid A (if they're into deep dives)

elena: comedy: Conan O'Brien Needs A Friend — great if you want celeb interviews that feel like chats

maya: Perfect, thanks folks! gonna make a playlist of these recs for the next commute. :sparkles:
